fields.help_en:
Source of playback, the UUID for configuring playback control capabilities.

Can be empty. Default value is "default"
fields.help_zh:
播放来源,配置播控能力的唯一标识

可空，默认为default
fields.name: play_from

fields.help_en:
Content type for playback.

Values: "content" for content, "album" for album, "collect" for playlist
fields.help_zh:
播放内容类型

内容：content；专辑：album；歌单：collect
fields.name: content_type

element_fields.help_en:
Third-party ID.

If the item is content, this is the content ID. If the item is an album, this is the album ID
element_fields.help_zh:
三方id

如果是内容则是内容id；如果是专辑则是专辑id
element_fields.name: raw_id

fields.help_en:
List of playback content.

If the content type is "content", multiple items are supported. If the content type is "album", only the first item takes effect
fields.help_zh:
播放内容列表

若是内容，支持多个；若是专辑，只有第一个有效
fields.name: content_list

fields.help_en:
Playback index

Can be empty. Default value is 0, indicating playback starts from the beginning
fields.help_zh:
播放的index

可空。默认为0，表示从头播放
fields.name: index

fields.help_en: Indicates whether album playback should continue from the last position. For example, if the last session stopped at episode 5, playback resumes from episode 5. Default value is true
fields.help_zh: 专辑是否续播，比如上次专辑听到第五集，是否继续从第五集开始。默认为true
fields.name: need_album_continued

fields.help_en:
Playback pattern

List loop: Repeat; Shuffle: Shuffle; Single track loop: RepeatOne; Sequential playback: Normal
fields.help_zh:
播放模式

列表循环：Repeat；随机：Shuffle；单曲循环：RepeatOne；顺序播放：Normal
fields.name: play_mode

fields.help_en: System RequestId. The caller does not need to provide this; the system fills it in automatically
fields.help_zh: 系统RequestId，调用方不需要传 系统自动填写
fields.name: request_id

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the encoding type. Enter the Project ID of the product's project here. You can view it in the Tmall Genie AI Platform console.
fields.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，此处填写该产品所在项目的Project ID。请在天猫精灵AI平台的控制台中查看
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Type of device ID: OPEN_ID: The default device ID identity. UNION_ID: Device ID identity at the organization dimension. You must request an organization in advance on the Open Platform.
fields.help_zh: 设备Id的类型 ： OPEN_ID：默认的设备ID标识。 UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，需要提前在开放平台申请组织
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: Device ID. Enter the value of deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId.
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This parameter is required if IdType is UNION_ID.
fields.name: organization_id
